learning_outcomes.text: Possesses terminology related to cultural heritage management.
Possesses the theoretical background related to the protection and management of cultural heritage.
Understands the interaction between the theoretical and practical fields of cultural heritage management.
Possesses knowledge related to the presentation and interpretation of cultural heritage.
Possesses knowledge of current approaches in the field of cultural heritage protection and management.

syllabus_topics: Definition and scope of cultural heritage, basic concepts, institutions and organizations working in the field of cultural heritage management
International conventions, conceptual developments in cultural heritage management
UNESCO World Heritage Convention, World Heritage List and criteria, examples from World Heritage Sites
Protection and management of archaeological sites
Presentation and interpretation of cultural heritage
Conservation approach in Turkey, legal regulations and practices regarding the protection and management of cultural heritage
Turkey and the UNESCO World Heritage List, conservation and management practices in heritage sites
Protection and management of archaeological heritage in Turkey
Cultural heritage and risk management studies in Turkey
Presentation, interpretation, and visitor management of cultural heritage in Turkey
Presentation, interpretation, and visitor management of cultural heritage in Turkey
